apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.0.3

The MES shopping-bag icon now has a transparent background, both on the launcher and inside the store. Uses a standard vector launcher icon to avoid the scanner's black adaptive-icon background.

Browse MES apps, see installed versions and available updates, and install signed APKs directly from the phone. Includes search, release notes, download progress, offline catalog caching, and APK integrity and signing-certificate checks.

Android asks for installation approval. Enable Allow from this source for MES Store the first time you install an app.

apps.name: SignPad
apps.description: Sign bills of lading, scan shipments, and keep warehouse work moving.
apps.releaseNotes:
SignPad 1.6.1

Back from the driver step restores the shipper's handwriting for review or correction. Includes the inspection and loading workflow and signed BOL printing integration.

Install over the existing SignPad app to keep pairing and authorization. MES authorization is required to access company data.
